title: Path-only probe is rejected: a probe requires at least one assertion (acProbe anyOf, 0.9.0)
iWant: a probe to carry at least one of expectStatus, expectHeader, expectBody or selector
soThat: a probe that only names a path cannot resolve to a vacuous pass

acceptanceCriteria.description: Probe names a path and asserts nothing about the response (the 0.7.1 to 0.8.0 us-007 shape, rcf-lite FBS-218 finding BH-1).
